quotes.text: Did you do any paid work in the 7 days ending Sunday the [date], either as an employee or as self-employed?
Did you do any unpaid work in that week (ending Sunday the [date] for any business that you own?
...or (any unpaid work for a business) that a relative owns?

assessments.reasoning: The instrument defines work in questions WRKING, OWNBUS, and RELBUS as paid work or unpaid work done for a business owned by the respondent or a relative. Unpaid domestic and care work is not included in the definition of work. Instead, looking after the family or home is listed under reasons for not looking for work (NOLOWA, page 119), treating unpaid care and domestic work as a reason for economic inactivity rather than as work.
